measure.evidenceText: Google returned Hotel Pedraza in Buenos Aires and explicitly labels it 1-star, with Booking.com total-per-night $80 and nightly price with taxes and fees. The result does not expose explicit two-adult/two-guest one-room occupancy. Expedia rows had explicit two adults but were start-from prices and did not identify one-star class; Hotels.com rows were wrong or unspecified classes.
measure.referencePeriod: Result crawled 3 weeks before 2026-08-01; Booking quote shown without a one-night date
measure.searchQuery: site:google.com/travel/hotels Buenos Aires Argentina 1-star hotel 2 adults nightly price taxes
measure.reason: Rejected: the exact-city one-star candidate lacks explicit two-adult/one-room occupancy. Expedia's explicit-occupancy rows were start-from prices and had no one-star class, so no strict quote was accepted.
